Audience: every first-time Nevada Basic Class C applicant, and especially parents and drivers who carry children.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the belt and child-restraint thresholds are legal duties that apply from the first drive [A01], and the airbag and seating guidance prevents the most serious child injuries [A02].
Level: recall of a small set of exact age, height and model-year thresholds, with a few confusable pairs; low conceptual load.
Prerequisites: sec01 and sec02 (licensing basics); none of the driving-skill chapters.
